items.title: PCRS and NHS Wales primary care respiratory update, Cardiff, 20 October 2026
items.summary: PCRS is running a one-day essential primary care respiratory update in Cardiff on Tuesday 20 October 2026, with NHS Wales Performance and Improvement and members of the National Respiratory Audit Programme. A concentrated Welsh primary care respiratory audience.

items.title: Fisher and Paykel locked in as sole supplier for respiratory consumables at St George's
items.summary: St George's University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust has made a direct, sole-source award to Fisher and Paykel Healthcare worth £750,000 for invasive, non-invasive and nasal high-flow consumables, citing their compatibility with equipment the trust already has in place.

items.title: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV): vaccination for older adults
items.summary: Information on respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and the benefits of vaccination for adults and resources to promote the vaccination to older adults.

items.title: Acute respiratory illness in PPDs and the CYPSE
items.summary: Managing acute respiratory illness (ARI) in prisons and other prescribed places of detention (PPDs) and in the Children and Young People Secure Estate (CYPSE).

items.title: Paediatric lung assessments: tips for practice nurses
items.summary: At a recent Nursing in Practice virtual event, consultant nurse and doctoral researcher specialising in respiratory medicine, Aleksandra Gawlik-Lipinski, offered advice and guidance on paediatric lung assessments.

items.title: NHS Supply Chain awards National Respiratory Solutions Framework across 5 lots
items.summary: NHS Supply Chain has made award decisions on its new National Framework Agreement for Respiratory Solutions, covering respiratory therapy, anaesthesia and resuscitation, diagnostics and monitoring, nitrous oxide destruction, and respiratory support services.

items.title: Respiratory Solutions
Benefits of walking outweigh air pollution risk for COPD patients
items.summary: People with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) who live in areas with moderate to high air pollution can improve their long-term lung health with regular walking, a European study has found.

items.title: Vaping at home increases children’s asthma risk
items.summary: Children exposed to vaping at home are at increased risk of asthma flare-ups, according to new research.
